arguments.rule_content:
title: "Suspicious DLL Load by Print Spooler from Temp Directory"
id: "c5d3f2a1-9b4e-4f6a-8c2d-1e2f3b4a5c6d"
status: "experimental"
description: "Detects loading of DLLs from temporary directories by spoolsv.exe, indicative of PrintNightmare exploitation."
author: "SOC Team"
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    Image: "C:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe"
    EventID: 7
    ImageLoaded|contains: "\\Temp\\"
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - "Legitimate admin tasks"
level: high

arguments.rule_content:
title: Detect PrintNightmare DLL Load
id: d5c3e9f8-4b2a-4c5e-9f3a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: test
description: |
  Detects spoolsv.exe loading a DLL from a non-standard temporary directory, indicative of PrintNightmare exploitation.
author: SOC Analyst
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4688
    NewProcessName|endswith: '\\spoolsv.exe'
    ParentImage|contains: 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin scripts that load custom DLLs (rare)
level: high
